# orion suggestion

Suggested groups for related cards

```sh
orion suggestion <command> [options]
```

## orion suggestion find

Compute group suggestions

```sh
orion suggestion find [options]
```

| Argument            | Description                                                         |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--command <value>` | JSON array naming a command that groups the cards it reads on stdin |
| `--scope <value>`   | unsorted or all                                                     |
| `--dry-run`         | Show suggestions without writing                                    |
| `--json`            | Print JSON                                                          |

## orion suggestion list

List the stored group suggestions

```sh
orion suggestion list [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion suggestion apply

Apply group suggestions

```sh
orion suggestion apply [options] [ids...]
```

| Argument   | Description            |
| ---------- | ---------------------- |
| `[ids...]` | Suggestion ids         |
| `--all`    | Apply every suggestion |

## orion suggestion dismiss

Dismiss group suggestions

```sh
orion suggestion dismiss [options] [ids...]
```

| Argument   | Description              |
| ---------- | ------------------------ |
| `[ids...]` | Suggestion ids           |
| `--all`    | Dismiss every suggestion |
